description: NetBird is an open-source, WireGuard-based overlay network that connects devices, servers and containers into one private mesh — this template runs the self-hosted management server (with its embedded Dex identity provider) and the web dashboard on a single domain.
name: NetBird
seoDescription: Self-host NetBird on Dokploy in minutes: WireGuard mesh VPN with management server, embedded IdP and dashboard on one domain — free and open source.
